annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on the Proposal for a Directive and Regulation – simplification and strengthening of food and feed safety requirements
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on the Proposal for a Directive and Regulation – simplification and strengthening of food and feed safety requirements
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: EESC opinion on the Commission's food and feed safety simplification omnibus. It broadly welcomes simplification while insisting on precautionary standards. Only a small part concerns embodied technology: it supports allowing drone pesticide spraying, with safeguards against spray drift, permanent visual human oversight and certified operators.
key_provisions_or_claims: Welcomes simplification but not at the expense of food safety, environment or the precautionary principle.
Supports wider drone spraying of pesticides, with protections against spray drift.
Calls for permanent visual human oversight of drone spraying.
Recommends certification of farmers and contractors qualified for drone spraying.
Proposes amendments on EFSA role, grace periods, import tolerances, biocontrol and GMM-derived foods.
